d.d: Initialism of lunar orbit insertion: NASA terminology for a spacecraft maneuver to enter into orbit around the Moon.
The part of the body (of humans and quadrupeds) at each side of the backbone, between the ribs and hips.
Any of several cuts of meat taken from this part of an animal.
d.x: beef loin; goat loin; lamb loin; pork loin; also chicken loin and turkey loin (but these are almost always referred to as tenderloins)

d.d: A garment worn about the loins and covering the crotch.
To stand about without any aim or purpose; to stand about idly.
d.x: For some reason, they discourage loitering outside the store, but encourage it inside.

d.d: To remain at a certain place instead of moving on.
Of an aircraft, to remain in the air near a target.
A standing or strolling about without any aim or purpose.
The act or practice of lingering or remaining in a place aimlessly or without an obvious purpose.
d.x: NO LOITERING [sign posted where hanging out and causing trouble is unwelcome]

d.d: present participle and gerund of loiter
